routing.title: Routing
routing.description: Fills the executor and reviewer seats when an issue is created or its status changes.
routing.enabled_description: When off, seats are no longer filled; existing values are kept.
routing.model_description: The model that picks the tier. Pick one after saving an endpoint and key, or type a model id.
routing.model_discover_failed: Could not load models. Enter a model id manually.
routing.model_discover_empty: The endpoint returned no models. Enter a model id manually.
routing.threshold_description: Below this, work goes to the generic strong tier.
routing.stale_hours_description: After this long awaiting review with no active run, the reviewer is reminded.
routing.usage_priority_description: Within a tier, seats with ample usage go first
routing.allow_upshift_description: When every seat on the tier is tight, use an ample seat from the tier above
routing.continuation_description_on: Live: a ticket continuing a previous stage, its parent, or its batch goes to that work's executor when the seat is strong enough, online and has quota.
routing.continuation_description_shadow: Shadow mode: routing keeps its own pick and only notes in the assignment comment who this rule would pick. Turn on to apply it.
routing.load_description_on: Live: within the picked tier and direction, a seat with fewer runs in progress takes the ticket, but never past the usage tag: an idle Tight seat does not take work from a busier Normal or Ample one; when all are equally busy the usual order stands. If “Prefer the previous executor” is also on, it wins.
routing.load_description_shadow: Shadow mode: routing keeps its own pick and only notes in the assignment comment which less busy seat this rule would pick. Turn on to apply it.
routing.gateway_endpoint_workspace: The model id is sent to this workspace's own endpoint: {{host}}.
routing.gateway_endpoint_deployment: The model id is sent to the deployment's shared LLM endpoint: {{host}}.
routing.gateway_unset: No endpoint is available. Set an endpoint and key below.
routing.gateway_url_description: An OpenAI-compatible base URL; leave empty to use the deployment's shared endpoint.
routing.gateway_key_description: Stored encrypted and never shown again; clear it to use the deployment endpoint.
routing.gateway_key_unstorable: This deployment cannot store a workspace key. Contact whoever runs the server.

routing.gateway_default_model: That deployment's own default model is {{model}}.

off.detail: While off, everything works exactly as it did before.

incomplete.detail: A model that is turned on has no model id yet, so routing is not active.

enabled.detail: New issues are dispatched automatically, and each decision is explained in a comment on the issue.

ineffective.detail: The routing model is unavailable, so routing is not active. Check the model and endpoint.

routing.policy_save_error: Could not save. Your edit is still in the box.
routing.quota_description: Quota as last reported by each provider.
routing.seats_work_off: Work is off, so routing skips it
routing.judge_description: Reads the analysis answers and may raise the rule table's tier by one, with a reason. It cannot lower it.
routing.analysis_description: Reads the whole ticket and answers four multiple-choice questions: scope, clarity, cost of a mistake, whether a person must decide. When a ticket stops, it writes where it is stuck.
routing.analysis_source_description: Choose the API gateway or a subscribed runtime.
routing.analysis_model_description: Any OpenAI-compatible chat model. Its facts are cached per ticket and recomputed only when the title or description changes.
routing.analysis_url_description: An OpenAI-compatible base URL. Leave both fields empty to use the deployment’s shared endpoint.

modes.none: Neither model is on: no model is called, and every ticket goes to the fallback tier.
modes.analysis: Analysis only: the analysis model answers the questions and the rule table sets the tier.
modes.analysis_judge: Both on: the rule table sets the tier, and the judge may raise it by one at most, never lower.
modes.judge: Judge only: nobody answers the questions, so the table's unanswered row sets the tier, and the judge may raise it by one.

routing.rules_description: After the analysis model answers, the first matching rule from the top sets the tier.
